meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文字、数据或品牌标志变成几秒钟的动效短片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想用几秒钟的动效视频讲清一个点,又不想动专业剪辑软件。
copy.tagline_en: Turn text, stats, or a brand mark into a few-second animated clip
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a few-second animated video that makes one point, without pro editing tools.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会做一支短的、以动效本身传达信息的设计型动效视频(无旁白),产出 MP4 或透明叠加视频。
howto.when: 当你要一支约 10 秒以内(最长约 30 秒)、没有旁白的动效片段时触发,例如动态文字、图表动效、logo 亮相等。更长、带旁白或多场景的需求会转给 /general-video,不确定时先走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 做一支 8 秒的动态大字标题,主题是“新年促销”
say.note: 先问一个澄清问题,完成后问你预览还是渲染

say.text: 把这组数据做成一段图表动效,不要旁白
say.note: 走 charts 类别,先规划再构建并校验

say.text: 用这个 logo 做一支品牌亮相短片,透明背景
say.note: 可渲染为透明叠加层(--format webm)

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude builds a short, design-led motion graphic where motion carries the message — no narration — and renders it to MP4 or a transparent overlay.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want a short, unnarrated motion piece (usually under 10s, up to ~30s), such as kinetic type, chart animation or a logo sting. Longer, narrated or multi-scene requests go to /general-video.

say_en.text: Make an 8-second kinetic typography title about our spring sale
say_en.note: Asks one question, then builds and offers preview or render

say_en.text: Turn this dataset into a chart animation, no narration
say_en.note: Uses the charts category; plans, builds and verifies

say_en.text: Make a brand logo reveal from this logo, transparent background
say_en.note: Can render as a transparent overlay (--format webm)
